facts.fact: 她的天赋神话破产：从来就没有什么 special gift。
facts.anchor: I don’t have a special gift, never have.

facts.fact: 她的人格史：在女人的「人设」之间挤进挤出——像紧身连衣裙。
facts.anchor: I’ve spent my years squeezing in and out of different women’s personalities like they were bodycon dresses

facts.fact: 她从没求助过——羞耻挡住了所有出口，而现在她比任何时候都需要。
facts.anchor: Help was always something I’ve been too ashamed to ask for, and I need it now more than ever.

facts.fact: 三连复读：他从来没爱过我。
facts.anchor: He never loved me. He never loved me. He never loved me.

facts.fact: 她的平等洞察：他是个骗子——她也是；人人都会装。
facts.anchor: He’s a liar, just like me. Everyone is capable of pretending.

facts.fact: 他反手一巴掌抽在 Blair 脸上。
facts.anchor: the back of his hand skelps her across the face

facts.fact: 他拉开餐具抽屉、操起最锋利的刀——刀面平贴上她的喉咙。
facts.anchor: He pulls open the cutlery drawer, almost taking it off the runners, and arms himself with the sharpest blade he owns.

facts.fact: 肯定语头一回用于冲锋：我有力、我勇敢、我是好人——然后她扑了上去。
facts.anchor: ‘I am capable. I am brave. I am a good person.’ And then I throw myself towards them.
